title: INC-1043 Authentication Gateway report
content: INC-1043 incident report. Authentication Gateway. Opened 2026-04-16T02:08:00Z. Impact began 2026-04-16T02:00:00Z: login and token refresh requests failed with TLS handshake errors. Preliminary hypothesis H1 was a new identity provider policy rejecting old OAuth scopes. Conflicting preliminary hypothesis H2 was DNS propagation sending users to a retired gateway. Neither hypothesis was confirmed. Investigators compared application logs, service metrics, configuration changes, and independent checks. Confirmed root cause at 2026-04-16T03:21:00Z: the public TLS certificate for auth.internal.example expired at 02:00 UTC because the renewal job had a disabled service account. Supporting evidence: openssl x509 reported notAfter=2026-04-16T02:00:00Z; gateway logs recorded certificate_expired for every failing handshake. Remediation: issued and installed a replacement certificate, re-enabled the renewal service account, and added 30-day expiry alerts. Resolved 2026-04-16T03:21:00Z. Evidence source IDs: INC-1043-LOGS, INC-1043-RUNBOOK, INC-1043-POSTMORTEM. This report source ID is INC-1043-REPORT.
